latestVersion.changelog: Parser fixes after testing on real PDF/DOCX CVs: support Spanish abbreviated months with period (Ago., Ene., Dic.), fallback for multi-column PDFs where experience section gets fragmented, added Spanish skill keywords (arquitectura empresarial/de soluciones, gobierno de IA, microservicios, liderazgo tecnico, agentes/agentico) and Spanish title nouns (arquitecto, ingeniero, lider, etc.). Tested against EN/ES x PDF/DOCX: 15.6-17.6 years detected (was 1.4-3.4), 20-27 skills (was 5-13).
